_comment: Central NVIDIA agent configuration. API key is NEVER stored here — loaded from NVIDIA_API_KEY env var only.

discovery.description: Detects whether raw text is a genuine government recruitment notification

classification.description: Classifies job category, qualification level, and recruiting body

extraction.description: Extracts all structured fields from the notification text

normalization.description: Normalizes dates, salary figures, fee amounts, and enums to standard formats

duplicate.description: Checks for duplicate or near-duplicate notifications already in the database

enrichment.description: Enriches extracted data with age-relaxation rules, application steps, and eligibility details

content.description: Generates the candidate-facing overview, how-to-apply steps, and summary content

seo.description: Generates slug, meta title, meta description, keywords, and structured data

verification.description: Hard-gate verifier: cross-checks every extracted field against the original source evidence

quality.description: Quality control: scores completeness, consistency, and readability of the final record

draft.description: Assembles the final GovtJobDraft database record from all agent outputs

final_qa.description: Final QA + Auto-Fix agent: inspects all previous outputs, fixes safe issues, routes unsolvable issues back
